verdict: Yes. House of Chikankari pitched handmade Chikankari by Lucknow artisans on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Chikankari has a GI tag and loyal buyers, and a brand that proves its pieces are hand-embroidered can charge a real premium.
angle: Lucknow's Chikankari cluster has a large base of women embroiderers. Buyers struggle to tell handwork from machine copies, so showing makers, hours and techniques builds trust. Modern cuts help reach younger buyers.
